paper_title: Dark Matter from Axion Strings with Adaptive Mesh Refinement
coupling_convention: x = f_a in GeV, y = m_a in eV (post-inflation QCD axion DM prediction band)
notes: Theoretical/cosmological prediction, not an experimental exclusion: AMR simulations of axion string networks in the post-inflation PQ-breaking scenario predict the QCD axion DM mass in the range ma = (40, 180) microeV, corresponding to fa in (3.1e10, 1.4e11) GeV (Eq. 2 and Discussion). Endpoints paired via inverse fa-ma relation: fa=3.1e10 GeV <-> ma=180 microeV (=1.8e-4 eV), fa=1.4e11 GeV <-> ma=40 microeV (=4.0e-5 eV). Central value for exactly scale-invariant spectrum (q=1): ma = 65 +/- 6 microeV (fa ~ 8.5e10 GeV). Uncertainty band derives from spectral index q in (0.98, 1.06) at 1-sigma, so stated confidence_level of 0.95 is nominal; the band is effectively ~1-sigma. No coupling constant (g_agamma, g_ae, etc.) is constrained; the result lives on the f_a - m_a plane, so AxionMass is appropriate.
